comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 returns 1 when any comment engages a specific example or premise from the OP argument. That engagement can be addressing, questioning, rebutting or building on it, and it can be a paraphrase or a direct naming. Item 1 returns 1 only when a comment contains a direct verbatim or near-verbatim quotation (e.g. blockquote) of OP title or body text, and paraphrases are explicitly excluded. Item 0 is broader in mechanism but restricts the target to a cited example or premise. Item 1 counts any quoted OP text but only quotation. The null rules also differ: item 0 needs argument and a determinable target, while item 1 is null on missing title/argument only when absence cannot be established.
